Asha (CSM): Heads-up: TidalWave dedicated commissioning tomorrow 08:30 PT. Committed: 18 GPUs across pools blue/green. Target steady ~7k qps, burst up to 16k. Need signoff on autoscale, priming plan, and a short go-live rehearsal with customer's infra team at 15:30 PT. Can team confirm?
Dmitri (SRE): I can run the load. Proposed window 08:30-10:00 PT: seed 20m, steady 50m @7k, then two 10m ramped bursts. Tool: `rb-load --plan tidalwave_steady --qps 7000 --dur 3000` then `--plan tidalwave_burst --qps 16000 --dur 600`. Will stream to #eng-sre.
Rina (SE): I'll own KV seeding and priming. Command: `rbw-seed --pools=blue,green --concurrency=40 --duration=1200`. Recommend enabling KV persistence on blue for long-context workloads.
Asha (CSM): Also need a billing guardrail for the window and a quick renewal signal: if steady p95 <260ms and cost/unit within 8% of forecast mark renewal green.
billing-bot: temporary_quota_increase tidalwave -> approved amount=$1300 window=2026-06-08T15:00:00Z tag=TIDAL-COMM
Dmitri (SRE): Autoscale proposal: min=2, target_util=0.66, max=22, scale_up_window=45s, scale_down_delay=420s. Overflow fallback -> route to redwood-hosted/eco-fallback. Also enabling per-route tracing for the run.
Omar (PM): Two asks: 1) collect p50/p95/p99 per-route and error-rate; 2) capture a 8k-sample of outputs (steady+bust) for quick evals to detect tokenization/regression.
Rina (SE): I'll attach a small chaos check: terminate one replica during second burst to validate graceful failover. Runbook snippet:
```
# seed
rbw-seed --pools blue,green --concurrency 40 --duration 1200
# steady
rb-load --plan tidalwave_steady --qps 7000 --dur 3000 --out ./reports/tidal_steady.json
# burst
rb-load --plan tidalwave_burst --qps 16000 --dur 600
```
Dmitri (SRE): Alerts: p95 latency >300ms OR 5xx_rate>0.75% => page oncall. Watch `inference.tokens_per_sec`, `gpu_mem_free_mb`, `kv_cache_hit`. I'll post Grafana in 5m. If we see sustained tail >350ms we'll stop bursts and rerun controlled passes.
Asha (CSM): Action items:
- Dmitri: run load 08:30-10:00 PT, stream metrics + post dashboards
- Rina: seed 20m prior; run kill/fallback during burst; attach 8k sample outputs
- Omar: prepare quick eval script + renewal checklist by 07:30 PT
- Asha: run 15:30 PT enablement rehearsal with TidalWave ops (failover + billing) and capture feedback in CS tracker
ops-bot: scheduled job tidalwave-commissioning -> queued for 2026-06-08T15:25:00Z
Asha (CSM): Thanks team 44d This thread is canonical for the run. Ping me immediately if keys or billing fail.
